title: Deformations of Kähler and Balanced Hyperbolicity
summary: We study the deformation stability of Kähler and balanced hyperbolicity. We prove that Kähler hyperbolicity is open under arbitrary small holomorphic deformations, but need not be closed, even in families of smooth projective surfaces. By contrast, balanced hyperbolicity is not open in general: in every complex dimension at least five, we construct a balanced hyperbolic central fibre with non-balanced nearby fibres.
